<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,viewport-fit=cover,maximum-scale=1,user-scalable=no"><meta name="theme-color" content="#063f32"><meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-capable" content="yes"><title>Emerald Mahjong Worlds v12 — v8 · Real Nature Recordings</title>
<style>
/* Stable UI typography across Android system font-size and display-size preferences.
   CSS px remain fixed for text; viewport-dependent layout stays responsive. */
html{font-size:16px!important;-webkit-text-size-adjust:none!important;text-size-adjust:none!important}
body,button,input,select,textarea{-webkit-text-size-adjust:none!important;text-size-adjust:none!important}

:root{--cream:#fff5dd;--gold:#f2c67c;--midgold:#bd7c42;--pine:#064235;--wood:#643b25;--safeB:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px);--safeT:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px)}
*{box-sizing:border-box;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}html,body{height:100%;width:100%;margin:0;overflow:hidden}body{font-family:ui-sans-serif,system-ui,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',sans-serif;background:#022e26;color:var(--cream);touch-action:manipulation;user-select:none;-webkit-user-select:none}button{cursor:pointer;font:inherit;color:inherit;border:0;background:transparent;touch-action:manipulation}button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #ffde95;outline-offset:3px}button:disabled{opacity:.36;filter:grayscale(.5);cursor:not-allowed}
#app{position:relative;width:100%;height:100%;height:100dvh;min-height:390px;overflow:hidden;isolation:isolate;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 49% 46%,#13846c 0%,#09614e 48%,#043e32 79%,#022c24 110%)}
#app:before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:0;opacity:.3;pointer-events:none;background:repeating-linear-gradient(100deg,transparent 0 46px,#063e3224 47px 50px,transparent 51px 84px),radial-gradient(ellipse 55% 50% at 10% 100%,#79d1a522,transparent),radial-gradient(ellipse 30% 30% at 90% 0,#9dddbf16,transparent)}
#app:after{content:'❧';position:absolute;font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:min(85vw,470px);color:#b8e9b6;opacity:.055;left:-15%;top:28%;transform:rotate(-35deg);pointer-events:none;z-index:0}
.screen{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:2;display:flex;flex-direction:column}.hidden{display:none!important}#vfx{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:28;pointer-events:none;width:100%;height:100%}
/* Main menu */
#home{align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;text-align:center;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#9d5a33a8 0 2%,transparent 2% 98%,#9d5a33a8 98%),repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,transparent 0 20%,#89522b22 20.5% 21%,transparent 21.5% 40%),linear-gradient(170deg,#d1a978 0%,#f6d9ab 37%,#bb8450 75%,#86532f 100%);color:#4c2a14}
#home:before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:-1;background:repeating-linear-gradient(0deg,transparent 0 9.2%,#5c3f2c26 9.4% 9.6%,transparent 9.8% 20%),linear-gradient(90deg,#9a632548,transparent 18% 82%,#86502648);pointer-events:none}
.home-nav{width:100%;display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;gap:10px;padding:calc(17px + var(--safeT)) 20px 0}.home-nav button{width:41px;height:41px;border-radius:50%;font-size:21px;color:#fae9ba;background:linear-gradient(#9d5937,#653518);border:2px solid #cf9857;box-shadow:0 4px #4f301e,0 7px 12px #6532116b}
.home-head{margin-top:-4px;display:flex;align-items:center;flex-direction:column}.home-topline{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.3em;font-weight:800;color:#774b28}.home-title{margin:13px 0 0;font:bold clamp(48px,12.5vw,83px)/.9 Georgia,serif;color:#512b17;letter-spacing:-.08em;text-shadow:0 3px #ffe9bd,0 6px 8px #8c582b85}.home-title span{display:block;font-size:.79em;letter-spacing:.025em;color:#fff6dd;text-shadow:0 3px #703a1a,0 6px 9px #5931168e}.home-sub{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.32em;color:#7a4a25;font-weight:800;margin-top:20px}
.home-medallion{position:relative;display:grid;place-items:center;width:min(52vw,206px);height:min(52vw,206px);border-radius:50%;margin:0 auto;background:repeating-conic-gradient(from -10deg,#bd8545 0 13deg,#ecc58d 13deg 18deg,#925526 19deg 26deg);border:6px solid #6b401f;box-shadow:0 16px 22px #65330b66,inset 0 0 0 6px #dfa667,0 0 0 8px #be83474d;animation:medallionFloat 5s ease-in-out infinite}.home-medallion:before{content:'';inset:12%;position:absolute;border:4px solid #7e4c28;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle at 40% 25%,#1b8b68,#09543e 74%);box-shadow:inset 0 6px 15px #001e1ba6,0 0 0 4px #f5cc83}.home-medallion:after{content:'麻';font:bold 74px Georgia,serif;color:#fff5cb;text-shadow:2px 4px #063c30;z-index:1}
@keyframes medallionFloat{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateY(-5px)}}
.home-actions{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:13px;align-items:center;width:min(88%,380px);margin-bottom:calc(30px + var(--safeB));z-index:1}.big-btn{width:100%;min-height:58px;border-radius:18px;border:2px solid #f7d49a;color:#fff9e8;text-shadow:0 2px #6e361b;background:linear-gradient(#f4bd77 0%,#e68e4b 35%,#bc632e 74%,#a34b27 100%);box-shadow:inset 0 4px #ffe4b59b,inset 0 -4px #78341968,0 7px #683819,0 12px 18px #542d168c;font-weight:900;font-size:18px;letter-spacing:.02em;transition:transform .12s}.big-btn:active{transform:translateY(4px);box-shadow:inset 0 2px #ffe4b59b,0 2px #683819}.big-btn.secondary{background:linear-gradient(#a46c40,#6a3e26);min-height:46px;font-size:14px;border-color:#e8bf7a}.home-actions small{color:#654226;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.1em;margin-top:11px}
/* game top */
#game{padding-top:var(--safeT)}.topbar{height:52px;min-height:52px;flex:0 0 52px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:5px 14px}.round{display:grid;place-items:center;width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:50%;background:linear-gradient(#ad733d,#704022);border:2px solid #e7b777;box-shadow:0 3px 0 #3e271b,0 5px 7px #02291f7c,inset 0 2px #f6d6a05a;font-size:21px;font-weight:800}.game-name{font:bold 23px Georgia,serif;text-shadow:0 2px 2px #002d21;color:#fff4d3}.game-name em{font-style:normal;color:#ffcc7e}.game-name small{display:block;text-align:center;font:700 9px system-ui;letter-spacing:.23em;color:#bddfce;margin-top:-1px}
.scorebar{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-evenly;gap:3px;margin:0 16px;min-height:47px;flex:0 0 47px}.score-group{text-align:center;min-width:65px}.score-group label{display:block;font-size:10px;color:#bce0c7;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.095em}.score-group strong{display:block;color:#fff7dc;font-size:21px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.16;text-shadow:0 2px #083e31;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.progress{width:calc(100% - 34px);margin:0 17px 6px;height:3px;flex:0 0 3px;background:#013e3199;border-radius:9px;overflow:hidden}.progress div{height:100%;width:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#ffd480,#ffedae);box-shadow:0 0 10px #ffdfa2;transition:width .4s}
/* Collection tray: four slots */
.tray-wrap{--tray-tile-w:38px;--tray-tile-h:47px;--tray-gap:1px;flex:0 0 auto;position:relative;margin:1px auto 0;width:min(91%,430px);height:86px;z-index:4}.tray-legend{font-size:9px;text-align:center;font-weight:800;color:#f5ddb3;letter-spacing:.18em;text-shadow:0 1px #003d30;margin-bottom:4px}.tray-wood{height:67px;border-radius:13px;border:3px solid #e0b071;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#91532e 0%,#5a301e 15%,#764324 53%,#4d2c20 100%);box-shadow:0 5px 0 #3e2419,0 11px 13px #001d1770,inset 0 3px #f0bd6b8f,inset 0 -4px #2819128a;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:7px;padding:5px 9px;position:relative}.tray-wood:before{content:'';inset:2px;position:absolute;pointer-events:none;border:1px solid #f4d19a3a;border-radius:10px}.tray-slot{position:relative;min-width:0;flex:0 0 calc(var(--tray-tile-w) + var(--tray-gap)*2 + 2px);width:calc(var(--tray-tile-w) + var(--tray-gap)*2 + 2px);height:calc(var(--tray-tile-h) + var(--tray-gap)*2 + 2px);aspect-ratio:38/47;border-radius:6px;background:linear-gradient(#3d281d,#523326);box-shadow:inset 0 3px 5px #1a0f0bc7,0 1px #d9a36a6f;border:1px solid #ae764d84;display:grid;place-items:center;overflow:visible}.tray-slot.empty:before{content:'✦';color:#d1ae7754;font-size:15px}.tray-slot .tray-tile{width:var(--tray-tile-w);height:var(--tray-tile-h);--w:var(--tray-tile-w);--h:var(--tray-tile-h);position:relative;transform:scale(.99);filter:drop-shadow(1px 2px 1px #050b078c);z-index:2;animation:slotLand .21s cubic-bezier(.1,1.4,.4,1) both}.tray-slot .tray-tile .tile-face{left:0;right:3px;bottom:3px}.tray-slot .tray-tile .tile-side{top:2px;left:2px}.tray-slot .tray-tile .symbol{width:92%;height:90%}.tray-slot .tray-tile .char-main,.tray-slot .tray-tile .wind-symbol,.tray-slot .tray-tile .dragon-red,.tray-slot .tray-tile .dragon-green{font-size:calc(var(--h)*.62)}.tray-slot .tray-tile .char-sub{font-size:calc(var(--h)*.12)}.tray-slot .tray-tile.match-leave{animation:slotMatch .32s ease-in forwards}.tray-slot.flash{animation:slotFlash .28s linear 2}.tray-slot button.tray-tile{padding:0;background:none;border:0}
@keyframes slotLand{from{transform:scale(.65) translateY(-15px);opacity:.5}to{transform:scale(1);opacity:1}}@keyframes slotMatch{20%{transform:scale(1.23);filter:brightness(1.8)}100%{transform:scale(0) rotate(25deg);opacity:0}}@keyframes slotFlash{50%{box-shadow:0 0 22px #ffe5a7,inset 0 0 15px #ffe099}}
.tray-help{position:absolute;right:0;top:0;min-width:21px;min-height:21px;border-radius:40px;padding:1px 4px;font-size:10px;border:1px solid #b4d9bd;color:#d3e9d9;background:#04503b}
/* board */
.board-space{flex:1;position:relative;min-height:0;margin:4px 5px 0;overflow:visible;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}.board-space:before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:2% 1%;pointer-events:none;border:1px solid #c2e3af12;border-radius:30px;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 50%,#53b79d0a,transparent 68%)}.board{width:100%;height:100%;max-width:650px;position:relative;overflow:visible;isolation:isolate}
.tile{position:absolute;width:var(--w);height:var(--h);padding:0;border:none;background:transparent;z-index:var(--z);transform:translateZ(0);filter:drop-shadow(1px 4px 2px #00241baf);transition:filter .12s ease,transform .15s ease,opacity .18s ease;touch-action:manipulation;outline:none;border-radius:7px}.tile-side{position:absolute;left:3px;top:5px;right:0;bottom:0;border-radius:7px;background:linear-gradient(102deg,#e8e4d1,#a2bca4 40%,#498c69 88%);box-shadow:inset -2px -3px #2b5b43,2px 3px #01271b9c}.tile-face{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;right:5px;bottom:6px;border-radius:6px;background:linear-gradient(124deg,#fff 2%,#fffef7 46%,#f1f0df 80%,#dfe2d0 100%);border:1px solid #dfe2cf;box-shadow:inset 0 2px #fff,inset -1px -2px 2px #bdc9b2,1px 0 #93ba9d;display:grid;place-items:center;overflow:hidden}.tile-face:after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:2px;border:1px solid #fff9;border-radius:4px;pointer-events:none}.symbol{width:94%;height:94%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;position:relative;pointer-events:none}.tile svg{width:100%;height:100%}.tile .char-main{font-family:'Noto Serif CJK SC','Droid Sans Fallback',serif;color:#174b80;font-weight:900;font-size:calc(var(--h)*.62);line-height:1;text-shadow:.5px 1px #d5d5c0}.tile .char-sub{position:absolute;bottom:1%;right:4%;color:#186340;font:bold calc(var(--h)*.13) Georgia,serif}.tile .wind-symbol{font-family:'Noto Serif CJK SC','Droid Sans Fallback',serif;font-weight:bold;color:#12477b;font-size:calc(var(--h)*.63)}.tile .dragon-red{font:bold calc(var(--h)*.64) Georgia,serif;color:#bf291e}.tile .dragon-green{font:bold calc(var(--h)*.64) Georgia,serif;color:#0b764d}
.tile.blocked .tile-face{filter:brightness(.76) saturate(.62)}.tile:not(.blocked):active{transform:translateY(-7px) scale(1.06);filter:drop-shadow(1px 4px 5px #ffe0a5)}.tile.hinted .tile-face{animation:hintGlow .45s ease-in-out 5 alternate}.tile.match-glow .tile-face{background:#fffce7;box-shadow:0 0 12px #ffe78c,inset 0 0 5px #ffda80}.tile.zen-tiles .tile-face{background:linear-gradient(#f9fffc,#def2de);border-color:#94b8a1}
@keyframes hintGlow{from{filter:brightness(1)}to{filter:brightness(1.5);box-shadow:0 0 17px #ffdd7f,inset 0 0 0 2px #ffbf47}}
.fly-tile{pointer-events:none;position:fixed!important;z-index:80!important;margin:0;animation:none!important;transition:transform .42s cubic-bezier(.19,.85,.28,1),opacity .32s ease,filter .4s ease!important;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 9px #fff0af)!important}.fly-tile .tile-face{box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #ffdaa1,0 0 15px 4px #ffe5a4}
/* action bar */
.dock{position:relative;z-index:5;flex:0 0 auto;height:96px;padding:9px 10px calc(6px + var(--safeB));display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:space-evenly;gap:2px;border-top:3px solid #d8a169;background:repeating-linear-gradient(7deg,#70412733 0 2px,transparent 2px 19px),linear-gradient(180deg,#98512c,#623622 45%,#48291d);box-shadow:0 -7px 20px #00251b93,inset 0 3px #ffdf9b3d}.tool{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-start;gap:5px;min-width:57px;position:relative}.tool-round{width:54px;height:54px;display:grid;place-items:center;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle at 45% 27%,#b67b42,#7b4027 65%,#522719);border:3px solid #e5b777;box-shadow:0 4px #432314,0 7px 9px #001a1585,inset 0 1px #fbd497a5;color:#fff0c7;font-size:26px;line-height:1}.tool:active .tool-round{transform:translateY(3px)}.tool-label{color:#ffe9c4;font-size:9px;font-weight:850;letter-spacing:.04em}.tool-count{position:absolute;top:-4px;right:0;min-width:19px;height:19px;border:1px solid #ffdc98;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;background:linear-gradient(#ffc16e,#d78b3f);font-size:11px;font-weight:900;color:#fff;z-index:1}
/* feedback */
#toast{position:absolute;left:50%;top:32%;transform:translate(-50%,12px);z-index:80;background:#062e27e8;color:#ffe3a5;border:1px solid #eac78684;padding:10px 17px;border-radius:40px;font-weight:800;font-size:13px;white-space:nowrap;pointer-events:none;opacity:0;transition:opacity .2s,transform .2s}#toast.show{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,0)}
#comboLayer{position:absolute;pointer-events:none;inset:0;z-index:50}.combo-text{position:absolute;left:50%;top:39%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(.35) rotate(-9deg);font:bold clamp(32px,9vw,56px) Georgia,serif;color:#ffe9a0;white-space:nowrap;-webkit-text-stroke:1.2px #7f3b1f;text-shadow:0 3px #66351b,0 0 20px #f4bd63,2px 8px 16px #00231c;animation:comboPop 1.15s cubic-bezier(.14,.86,.24,1) forwards}.combo-text small{display:block;font:bold 13px system-ui;text-align:center;color:#fff9da;letter-spacing:.2em;-webkit-text-stroke:0}.combo-text.special{color:#fff7c1;text-shadow:0 3px #774119,0 0 24px #ffb841}@keyframes comboPop{0%{opacity:0;transform:translate(-50%,-25%) scale(.25) rotate(-15deg)}25%{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1.1) rotate(4deg)}53%{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(.94) rotate(-3deg)}80%{opacity:1}100%{opacity:0;transform:translate(-50%,-125%) scale(.87) rotate(-7deg)}}
#flash{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:27;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 43%,#ffe4a94d,transparent 60%);pointer-events:none;opacity:0;transition:opacity .12s}.flashing{animation:boardFlash .52s ease-out!important}@keyframes boardFlash{0%{opacity:0}25%{opacity:.9}100%{opacity:0}}
/* dialogs */
.overlay{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:60;background:#001c17d7;backdrop-filter:blur(7px);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:18px}.modal{position:relative;width:min(100%,385px);max-height:min(92vh,780px);overflow-y:auto;border:2px solid #e5b975;border-radius:22px;padding:26px 23px;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 45% 0,#1f805e 0%,#0b523d 45%,#05362b 100%);box-shadow:0 15px 0 #00281e,0 20px 30px #00140ca9,inset 0 0 0 5px #eabc6921;color:#fff4d5;text-align:center}.modal h2{font:bold 35px Georgia,serif;margin:7px 0 11px}.modal p{font-size:13px;line-height:1.55;color:#cce3d6;margin:8px 0 18px}.modal-glyph{font-size:45px;color:#ffdd90;text-shadow:0 4px #4f2d1c}.modal .big-btn{font-size:16px;min-height:49px;margin:11px 0 0}.modal .big-btn.secondary{font-size:12px;min-height:43px;margin-top:9px}.modal-close{position:absolute;right:10px;top:6px;color:#fff1d8;font-size:27px;padding:5px}.settings-row{margin:15px 0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;text-align:left;border-bottom:1px solid #c8daa02d;padding-bottom:10px;font-size:14px;font-weight:700}.pill{font-weight:900;border:1px solid #e0bd76;border-radius:20px;background:#2a6549;min-width:65px;padding:7px 13px}.pill.on{background:#b17735;color:#fff5de}.howto{text-align:left;font-size:12px;line-height:1.6;color:#d1e6db}.big-number{font:bold 45px Georgia,serif;color:#ffe0a6}.stars{font-size:34px;letter-spacing:.12em;color:#ffdf84;animation:starSwing .9s ease-in-out}@keyframes starSwing{0%{transform:scale(.2);opacity:0}70%{transform:scale(1.15)}100%{transform:scale(1)}}
@media(max-height:740px){.topbar{height:43px;min-height:43px;flex-basis:43px}.round{height:33px;width:33px;font-size:18px}.game-name{font-size:19px}.scorebar{min-height:40px;flex-basis:40px}.score-group strong{font-size:18px}.tray-wrap{height:75px}.tray-wood{height:59px}.tray-wrap{--tray-tile-w:34px;--tray-tile-h:40px}.tray-wood{padding:4px 9px}.dock{height:79px;padding-top:7px}.tool-round{width:43px;height:43px;font-size:21px}.tool-label{font-size:8px}.home-title{font-size:clamp(39px,12vw,70px)}.home-medallion{width:min(37vw,150px);height:min(37vw,150px)}}
@media(max-width:350px){.game-name{font-size:19px}.tray-wrap{width:96%}.scorebar{margin:0 6px}.dock{padding-left:2px;padding-right:2px}.tool-round{width:47px;height:47px}.tool{min-width:47px}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.home-medallion{animation:none}.tile,.fly-tile{transition-duration:.05s!important}}

/* Inset pockets follow the actual portrait tile footprint, never a square. */
.tray-slot{box-sizing:border-box;box-shadow:inset 0 3px 8px #190d0bdc,inset 0 0 0 1px #24140f99,0 1px #c79a62b0;}
.tray-slot:after{content:'';position:absolute;pointer-events:none;inset:1px;border:1px solid #aa765448;border-radius:4px;z-index:3}
.ambience-select{font:700 12px ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif;max-width:172px;min-height:36px;color:#ffefd0;background:#1d604e;border:1px solid #d8b276;border-radius:9px;padding:5px 8px;outline-offset:3px}
.ambience-select option{color:#fff;background:#15503c}
.ambience-slider{width:135px;max-width:100%;accent-color:#efbc70;touch-action:auto}
.ambience-hint{font-size:10px!important;line-height:1.4!important;text-align:left;color:#a8d6c3!important;margin:1px 0 10px!important}
#settingsModal .settings-row{margin:11px 0;padding-bottom:8px}

/* responsive gesture-only game board; DOM state never waits for a collection animation */
.board .tile {touch-action:none;-webkit-touch-callout:none;user-select:none;-webkit-user-select:none;}
.board .tile.peek-drag {transition:none!important;filter:drop-shadow(2px 12px 9px #001b13aa) brightness(1.08);cursor:grabbing;}
.board .tile.peek-return {transition:transform .32s cubic-bezier(.18,.9,.24,1.05),filter .3s ease!important;}
.board .tile.peek-drag:active,.board .tile.peek-return:active{filter:drop-shadow(2px 12px 9px #001b13aa);}
.tile.mystery-tile .tile-face{background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 40% 23%,#bff5c9 0%,#377c63 18%,#135441 60%,#082e2b 100%);border:2px solid #b9daa5;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px #174533,inset 0 0 9px #03140ab8,1px 1px 2px #04150b;}
.tile.mystery-tile .tile-face:after{border:1px solid #d9edac8c;inset:4px;}
.tile.mystery-tile .mystery-mark{font:700 calc(var(--h)*.49) Georgia,serif;color:#f6e2ac;text-shadow:0 2px 3px #072a23,0 0 11px #f7e9a078;position:relative;z-index:1;line-height:1;}
.tile.mystery-tile .tile-face::before{content:'❖';position:absolute;inset:0;display:grid;place-items:center;color:#d9deb44d;font-size:calc(var(--h)*.78);pointer-events:none;}
.tile.flip-reveal .tile-face{animation:revealTile .28s ease-out both;}
@keyframes revealTile{0%{transform:rotateY(88deg) scale(.87);filter:brightness(1.5)}65%{transform:rotateY(-9deg) scale(1.045)}100%{transform:rotateY(0) scale(1)}}
/* Fourth play option stays compact in landscape-like short mobile viewports. */
.home-actions .mystery-launch{font-size:13px;min-height:40px;border-color:#d6d0a1;background:linear-gradient(#527e63,#315542);}
@media(max-height:790px){.home-actions{gap:8px;margin-bottom:calc(12px + var(--safeB))}.home-actions small{margin-top:1px}.home-actions .big-btn.secondary{min-height:39px}}

</style></head><body>
<div id="app"><div id="sceneBg" aria-hidden="true"></div><div id="flash"></div><canvas id="vfx" aria-hidden="true"></canvas><div id="comboLayer" aria-hidden="true"></div><div class="world-banner" id="worldBanner"><strong id="worldBannerTitle">ANCIENT EGYPT</strong><span id="worldBannerText">Golden river temples and carved relic tiles</span></div>
<section id="home" class="screen"><div class="home-nav"><button id="homeSettings" aria-label="Settings">⚙</button></div><div class="home-head"><div class="home-topline">THE COLLECTOR'S EDITION</div><h1 class="home-title">EMERALD<span>MAHJONG</span></h1><div class="home-sub">COLLECT · COMBINE · CELEBRATE</div></div><div class="home-medallion"></div><div class="world-preview" id="worldPreview"><strong>ANCIENT EGYPT</strong><span>WORLD JOURNEY · RANDOM SCENES</span></div><div class="home-actions"><button class="big-btn" id="play">▶ &nbsp; CONTINUE</button><button class="big-btn secondary" id="levelsOpen">▦ &nbsp; SELECT LEVEL</button><button class="big-btn secondary" id="daily">✦ &nbsp; DAILY CHALLENGE</button><button class="big-btn secondary" id="relax">❧ &nbsp; ZEN MODE</button><button class="big-btn secondary mystery-launch" id="mystery">◆ &nbsp; MYSTERY TILES</button><small>LARGE 6×7 TILES · OFFLINE · 4-SLOT COLLECTION</small></div></section>
<section id="game" class="screen hidden"><header class="topbar"><button class="round" id="back" aria-label="Back to main menu">‹</button><div class="game-name">EMERALD <em>MAHJONG</em><small>COLLECTOR'S EDITION</small></div><div class="world-chip" id="worldChip">CLASSIC MAHJONG</div><button class="round" id="levelsGame" aria-label="Choose level" title="Level map">▦</button><button class="round" id="pause" aria-label="Pause and settings">☰</button></header><div class="scorebar"><div class="score-group"><label>LEVEL</label><strong id="levelNum">1</strong></div><div class="score-group"><label>SCORE</label><strong id="scoreNum">0</strong></div><div class="score-group"><label>REMAINING</label><strong id="remainingNum">0</strong></div></div><div class="progress"><div id="progressFill"></div></div>
<div class="tray-wrap"><div class="tray-legend">✦ &nbsp; TILE COLLECTION &nbsp; ✦</div><div class="tray-wood" id="tray" aria-label="Four collection slots"></div><button class="tray-help" id="trayInfo" aria-label="Collection rules">?</button></div>
<div class="board-space" id="boardSpace"><div class="board" id="board" role="group" aria-label="Mahjong tile board"></div></div><footer class="dock"><button class="tool" id="shuffle"><span class="tool-count" id="shuffleCount">3</span><span class="tool-round">⤨</span><span class="tool-label">SHUFFLE</span></button><button class="tool" id="hint"><span class="tool-count" id="hintCount">5</span><span class="tool-round">✧</span><span class="tool-label">HINT</span></button><button class="tool" id="undo"><span class="tool-round">↶</span><span class="tool-label">UNDO</span></button><button class="tool" id="magic"><span class="tool-count" id="magicCount">2</span><span class="tool-round">✦</span><span class="tool-label">MAGIC</span></button></footer></section>
<div id="toast" role="status" aria-live="polite"></div>
<div class="overlay hidden" id="levelsModal"><div class="modal levels-modal"><button class="modal-close" data-close aria-label="Close stage map">×</button><div class="modal-glyph">◈</div><h2>WORLD JOURNEY</h2><p class="levels-subtitle" id="levelProgress">Complete levels to unlock special worlds</p><div class="levels-legend"><span>✦ Classic</span><span>☥ Egypt</span><span>❀ Japan</span><span>🔒 Locked</span></div><div class="levels-list"><div class="levels-grid" id="levelsGrid"></div></div><div class="stage-actions"><button class="big-btn secondary" id="levelsClose">BACK</button><button class="big-btn" id="levelsContinue">CONTINUE ➜</button></div></div></div>
<div class="overlay hidden" id="settingsModal"><div class="modal"><button class="modal-close" data-close aria-label="Close">×</button><div class="modal-glyph">❖</div><h2>Settings</h2><div class="settings-row"><span>Nature ambience</span><button class="pill" id="musicToggle">ON</button></div><div class="settings-row"><span>World music</span><button class="pill" id="worldMusicToggle">ON</button></div><div class="settings-row"><label for="worldMusicVolume">Music volume</label><div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px"><input id="worldMusicVolume" class="ambience-slider" type="range" min="0" max="100" step="5" value="22"><span id="worldMusicValue" style="font-size:12px;min-width:27px">22%</span></div></div>
<div class="settings-row"><label for="ambienceSelect">Nature soundtrack</label><select id="ambienceSelect" class="ambience-select" aria-label="Background sound choice"><option value="auto">World Ambience · Auto</option><option value="stream">Flowing Stream</option><option value="rain">Gentle Rain</option><option value="forest">Forest Breeze</option><option value="ocean">Gentle Ocean Waves</option></select></div>
<div class="settings-row"><label for="worldSelect">World journey</label><select id="worldSelect" class="ambience-select" aria-label="World theme selection"><option value="auto">Auto · follow level journey</option><option value="classic">Classic Mahjong</option><option value="egypt">Ancient Egypt</option><option value="japan">Sakura Shrine</option></select></div>
<div class="settings-row"><label for="ambienceVolume">Ambient volume</label><div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px"><input id="ambienceVolume" class="ambience-slider" aria-label="Ambient sound volume" type="range" min="0" max="100" step="5" value="35"><span id="ambienceValue" style="font-size:12px;min-width:28px">35%</span></div></div>
<p class="ambience-hint">Real field recordings only. No generated melody. In Auto mode, ambience follows the current world.</p><p class="ambience-hint" style="opacity:.7">CC0 field recordings • Credits: visionear, jackthemurray, J.Zazvurek, florianreichelt.</p><div class="settings-row"><span>Sound effects</span><button class="pill" id="sfxToggle">ON</button></div><div class="settings-row"><span>Vibration</span><button class="pill" id="vibrateToggle">ON</button></div><div class="settings-row"><span>Tile appearance</span><button class="pill" id="themeToggle">IVORY</button></div><button class="big-btn" data-close>RESUME</button><button class="big-btn secondary" id="restart">RESTART BOARD</button><button class="big-btn secondary" id="levelsSettings">STAGE MAP</button><button class="big-btn secondary" id="toMenu">MAIN MENU</button></div></div>
<div class="overlay hidden" id="helpModal"><div class="modal"><button class="modal-close" data-close>×</button><div class="modal-glyph">✦ ✦ ✦ ✦</div><h2>How to Play</h2><div class="howto"><p>The board always uses <b>up to 6 columns and 7 rows</b> for larger, clearer tiles.</p><p>Tap any <b>free Mahjong tile</b> to move it into one of the <b>4 slots</b> above the board.</p><p>When two matching tiles enter the collection, they vanish in a burst of light and earn points. Build consecutive matches for COMBO rewards.</p><p>A tile is free when nothing covers it and either its left or right side is open. Tap any stored tile to return it to the board.</p><p><b>QUICK TAPS:</b> Keep collecting while tiles are flying. You never need to wait for an animation to finish.</p><p><b>DRAG TO PEEK:</b> Touch and slide a tile aside to check what lies underneath. Release to let it glide home. Dragging never collects it.</p><p><b>MYSTERY TILES:</b> Tap a face-down tile to flip it and reveal its symbol; tap again to collect it. Hidden tiles appear in Mystery Mode and selected advanced levels.</p><p><b>SHUFFLE</b> rearranges remaining tile faces; <b>HINT</b> reveals a match; <b>UNDO</b> reverses an action; <b>MAGIC</b> instantly matches a collected tile with its twin. Don't fill all four slots with unmatched tiles!</p></div><button class="big-btn" data-close>LET'S PLAY!</button></div></div>
<div class="overlay hidden" id="fullModal"><div class="modal"><div class="modal-glyph">◆ ◆ ◆ ◆</div><h2>Collection Full!</h2><p>All four places are occupied. Return one tile to the board, use Magic or Undo to free some space.</p><button class="big-btn" id="fullUndo">↶ &nbsp; UNDO</button><button class="big-btn secondary" id="fullMagic">✦ &nbsp; USE MAGIC</button><button class="big-btn secondary" data-close>VIEW COLLECTION</button></div></div>
<div class="overlay hidden" id="stuckModal"><div class="modal"><div class="modal-glyph">✧</div><h2>No Match Available</h2><p>Shuffle the board or undo a move to keep your game going.</p><button class="big-btn" id="stuckShuffle">⤨ &nbsp; SHUFFLE</button><button class="big-btn secondary" id="stuckUndo">↶ &nbsp; UNDO</button><button class="big-btn secondary" id="stuckRestart">RESTART</button></div></div>
<div class="overlay hidden" id="winModal"><div class="modal"><div class="modal-glyph">✧ ❖ ✧</div><div class="stars" id="stars">★ ★ ★</div><h2 id="winTitle">Beautiful!</h2><p id="winText">All the tiles have found their pair.</p><div class="big-number" id="winScore">0</div><p>TOTAL SCORE</p><button class="big-btn" id="nextLevel">NEXT LEVEL ➜</button><button class="big-btn secondary" id="winMenu">MAIN MENU</button></div></div>
</div>
<script>
(()=>{'use strict';
const $=id=>document.getElementById(id),app=$('app'),board=$('board'),trayEl=$('tray');
const STORE='emerald-collector-v4';let saved={};try{saved=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(STORE)||'{}')}catch{}
const state={level:Math.max(1,+saved.level||1),score:+saved.score||0,tiles:[],tray:[],history:[],mode:'classic',seed:0,hints:5,shuffles:3,magic:2,combo:0,lastMatch:0,sound:saved.sound!==false,music:saved.music!==false,ambienceMode:['auto','stream','rain','forest','ocean'].includes(saved.ambienceMode)?saved.ambienceMode:'auto',ambienceVolume:Math.min(100,Math.max(0,Number.isFinite(+saved.ambienceVolume)?+saved.ambienceVolume:35)),vibrate:saved.vibrate!==false,theme:saved.theme||'ivory',worldMode:['auto','classic','egypt','japan'].includes(saved.worldMode)?saved.worldMode:'auto',activeWorld:'classic',activeWorldBackground:'',unlocked:Math.max(1,+saved.unlocked||+saved.level||1),worldMusic:saved.worldMusic!==false,worldMusicVolume:Math.min(100,Math.max(0,Number.isFinite(+saved.worldMusicVolume)?+saved.worldMusicVolume:22)),busy:false,paused:false,epoch:0,initialCount:0,gameStarted:0,mysteryCount:0};
const allModals=['levelsModal','settingsModal','helpModal','fullModal','stuckModal','winModal'];let audio=null,musicTimer=0,musicIndex=0,particles=[],rings=[],raf=0,toastTimer=0;
const snapshot=()=>({tiles:state.tiles.map(t=>({...t})),tray:[...state.tray],score:state.score,combo:state.combo,lastMatch:state.lastMatch,hints:state.hints,shuffles:state.shuffles,magic:state.magic});
const restoreSnapshot=s=>{state.epoch++;state.tiles=s.tiles.map(t=>({...t}));state.tray=[...s.tray];state.score=s.score;state.combo=s.combo;state.lastMatch=s.lastMatch;state.hints=s.hints;state.shuffles=s.shuffles;state.magic=s.magic;state.busy=false;closeModal();render();save()};
function save(){try{localStorage.setItem(STORE,JSON.stringify({level:state.level,unlocked:state.unlocked,worldMusic:state.worldMusic,worldMusicVolume:state.worldMusicVolume,score:state.score,sound:state.sound,music:state.music,ambienceMode:state.ambienceMode,ambienceVolume:state.ambienceVolume,vibrate:state.vibrate,theme:state.theme,worldMode:state.worldMode,active:state.mode==='classic'&&state.tiles.length?{level:state.level,tiles:state.tiles, tray:state.tray,score:state.score,hints:state.hints,shuffles:state.shuffles,magic:state.magic}:null}))}catch{}}
function rng(seed){return()=>{seed|=0;seed=seed+0x6d2b79f5|0;let t=Math.imul(seed^seed>>>15,1|seed);t=t+Math.imul(t^t>>>7,61|t)^t;return((t^t>>>14)>>>0)/4294967296}}
function shuffle(a,random){for(let i=a.length-1;i>0;i--){let j=Math.floor(random()*(i+1));[a[i],a[j]]=[a[j],a[i]]}return a}
const dateSeed=()=>{let d=new Date();return +(d.getFullYear()+String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')+String(d.getDate()).padStart(2,'0'))};
function positions(level){
// All layouts fit a strict 6-column x 7-row footprint, including elevated tiles.
const p=[],variant=(level-1)%5;
const add=(x,y,z)=>p.push({id:`${x}:${y}:${z}`,x,y,z});
for(let y=0;y<7;y++)for(let x=0;x<6;x++){
  if(variant===1&&(y===0||y===6)&&(x===0||x===5))continue;
  if(variant===2&&(y===2||y===4)&&(x===0||x===5))continue;
  if(variant===3&&(y===0||y===6)&&(x===0||x===1||x===4||x===5))continue;
  if(variant===4&&(y===1||y===5)&&(x===0||x===5))continue;
  add(x,y,0)
}
for(let y=2;y<=4;y++)for(let x=2;x<=3;x++)add(x,y,1);
for(let y=2;y<=3;y++)for(let x=2;x<=3;x++)add(x,y,2);
if(p.length%2)p.pop();return p}
function free(t,arr){if(t.removed)return false;for(let o of arr){if(o.removed||o.id===t.id)continue;if(o.z>t.z&&Math.abs(o.x-t.x)<.9&&Math.abs(o.y-t.y)<.9)return false}
let left=false,right=false;for(let o of arr){if(o.removed||o.id===t.id||o.z!==t.z||Math.abs(o.y-t.y)>.3)continue;if(Math.abs(o.x-(t.x-1))<.3)left=true;if(Math.abs(o.x-(t.x+1))<.3)right=true}return!left||!right}
function generate(level,seed){let coords=positions(level);for(let attempt=0;attempt<200;attempt++){let rand=rng(seed+attempt*18979),work=coords.map(p=>({...p,removed:false})),pairs=[];while(work.some(t=>!t.removed)){let available=shuffle(work.filter(t=>free(t,work)),rand);if(available.length<2)break;available[0].removed=available[1].removed=true;pairs.push([available[0].id,available[1].id])}if(pairs.length*2===coords.length){let types=[];while(types.length<pairs.length)types.push(...shuffle(Array.from({length:34},(_,i)=>i),rand));types=shuffle(types.slice(0,pairs.length),rand);let map={};pairs.forEach(([a,b],i)=>{map[a]=types[i];map[b]=types[i]});return coords.map(p=>({...p,type:map[p.id],removed:false}))}}throw Error('Could not generate playable layout')}
function applyMystery(tiles,seed,mode,level){
  const enabled=mode==='mystery'||(mode==='classic'&&level>=3&&level%3===0);
  tiles.forEach(t=>{t.hidden=false;t.revealed=true});
  if(!enabled)return;
  const rand=rng((seed^0x53ACFD17)>>>0);
  const initiallyFree=shuffle(tiles.filter(t=>free(t,tiles)),rand);
  const rest=shuffle(tiles.filter(t=>!initiallyFree.includes(t)),rand);
  const count=Math.min(14,Math.max(6,Math.floor(tiles.length*(mode==='mystery'?.32:.20))));
  [...initiallyFree.slice(0,Math.min(5,count)),...rest].slice(0,count).forEach(t=>{t.hidden=true;t.revealed=false});
}

function dots(n){const colors=['#c92e24','#0f774d','#194f7f'];return `<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100">${dotCoords(n).map(([x,y],i)=>{let r=n>=7?9:12,c=colors[i%3];return `<circle cx="${x+1}" cy="${y+2}" r="${r+2}" fill="#c2c2aa"/><circle cx="${x}" cy="${y}" r="${r}" fill="${c}"/><circle cx="${x}" cy="${y}" r="${r*.65}" fill="#f7eed6"/><circle cx="${x}" cy="${y}" r="${r*.4}" fill="${c}"/><circle cx="${x-2}" cy="${y-2}" r="2" fill="white" opacity=".8"/>`}).join('')}</svg>`}
function bamboo(n){const xy=n===1?[[50,50]]:n===2?[[30,48],[70,48]]:n===3?[[50,17],[30,65],[70,65]]:n===4?[[30,25],[70,25],[30,75],[70,75]]:n===5?[[30,23],[70,23],[50,50],[30,78],[70,78]]:n===6?[[25,20],[50,20],[75,20],[25,77],[50,77],[75,77]]:n===7?[[50,15],[25,42],[50,42],[75,42],[25,75],[50,75],[75,75]]:n===8?Array.from({length:8},(_,i)=>[25+(i%2)*50,14+Math.floor(i/2)*24]):Array.from({length:9},(_,i)=>[23+(i%3)*27,16+Math.floor(i/3)*33]);return `<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100">${xy.map(([x,y],i)=>{let c=['#0e8a59','#c3452a','#0c6547'][i%3];return `<g transform="translate(${x} ${y}) rotate(${i%3===0?-10:6})"><rect x="-6" y="-15" width="12" height="30" rx="5" fill="${c}"/><path d="M0 -12v24M-5 -1h10" stroke="#ffefcc" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M-8 -12q-8 8 0 12M8 2q8 7 0 12" stroke="${c}" stroke-width="2" fill="none"/></g>`}).join('')}</svg>`}
